company.shortDescription: GroMo is a financial product selling app which empowers every Indian to earn money by selling insurance, credit cards, savings accounts etc.
company.description:
GroMo is the best financial product selling app using which every Indian can earn over INR 1 lakh every month by selling insurance policies, credit cards, savings account, Demat account, loans and many other financial products.

Anyone can start working using GroMo with zero investment. With the GroMo mobile app, you can work from anywhere & sell all kinds of insurance, including health insurance, motor insurance and life insurance etc. You can also sell various financial products like Credit Cards, Savings Accounts, Demat Account, Loans and earn upto rupees 3,000 per sale. 

GroMo wants to financially empower every Indian and give them the right to earn. Here are some of the best features of GroMo:
 - Easy to use Mobile app
 - Instant payouts to bank account
 - Wide range of financial products
 - Training and certification
 - Quick customer support

Download the GroMo app now and start earning without any investment. Become a GroMo partner and sell financial products from different brands to your customers and earn over rupees 1,00,000 per month. 

With the GroMo financial app, you get instant income and freedom to work as per your own convenience. You can directly reach out to your customers using GroMo app and share the product links with them. 

We have 14 lakh+ partners who believe that GroMo is one of the best money earning apps in India. Our aim is to keep all of our GroMo partners happy and help them earn regular income.

You can start your online business with us today @ zero investment and sell financial products from best financial brands. Sell Insurance policies including life insurance, motor insurance, health insurance and more. Sell bank products like credit cards, savings accounts, Demat accounts, line of credits & loans from brands like Axis bank, IndusInd bank, Kotak Mahindra bank, Yes Bank, IDFC First bank, Jupiter, NiyoX, Paytm Money, Freecharge, Bajaj Finserv, and many others.

GroMo is a great platform to sell financial products. Trust us, you won’t find a better way to earn extra online without investment. Your customers will be happy to activate so many brand products with you and you will be happy to earn more income from home, all in one app. 

You can even build a team through referrals and boost your earning with our best app to make money. Here’s is a list of GroMo features you would love: 

1. Get educated: Upskill with our free online courses and webinars and become a certified financial advisor while still doing home based work.

2. Manage your customers: Manage your customers and track their lead status in your GroMo App. Moreover, you can set up reminders to follow up with your customers.

3. Engage your customers: Keep your audience engaged with personalized content, website and visiting cards so that selling financial products from different brands becomes easier.

4. Refer and earn: Take full advantage of our fantastic referral policy and refer people in your network to GroMo on a regular basis.

5. Track your earnings: Use your in-app wallet to keep track of your earnings and instantly transfer money to your bank account in one-click.

6. Data security : Securely maintain customer data in your financial app without worrying about any data safety issues.

Get ready to earn money without investment with GroMo. Download our financial app today and start earning money from home.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series A round raised $11,000,000, or 95.03% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $3,396,387 to $48,327,802, a 14.23x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 38 (+0 over 90 days) and market heat at 7 (-1).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include PolicyBazaar, Zopper, CRED.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
caveats: Similarity scores are algorithmic matches, not verified direct competitors.
